judgment.rationale: A hotkey-registration or state defect remains possible, but Window Hopper intentionally cycles eligible windows of the foreground application, not the general Alt+Tab set. The missing discriminator is the exact foreground app/window scenario, not the already-provided layout or OS build.

comment.body: Thanks for correcting the Norwegian defaults and listing the reinstall/shortcut tests; please do not repeat those resets or send the existing report again. Window Hopper cycles windows of the current application, rather than all applications like Alt+Tab. Could you name the exact foreground application and number of its separate top-level windows when the shortcut does nothing? Please also try two separate windows of one ordinary desktop application, focus one, and use your currently configured next/previous shortcut. Tell us whether that controlled same-application case also does nothing. That separates intentional empty/single-window behavior from a hotkey or enumeration regression.
